gbm_population_evidence.quote: MGMT-Methylated Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma (GBM); Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Multiforme
Participants must have confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4, IDH wildtype, either by histological or molecular criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: The investigators are testing whether G-CSF can reduce the negative side effects from radiation and chemotherapy on brain health.
The study aims to evaluate G-CSF's effects on brain health and cognitive function.

candidate_flag.reason: G-CSF is given for neuroprotection/cognition (supportive), but OS, PFS and TTP are registered secondary outcomes; if these count as a stated antitumour outcome, G-CSF would be a candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must have confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4, IDH wildtype, either by histological or molecular criteria.

role_evidence.quote: The investigators are specifically testing the effects of G-CSF on brain structure, cognitive function, and general brain health, and the safety and tolerability of G-CSF.

agents.drug_class_hint: recombinant granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (haematopoietic growth factor), used here for neuroprotection

flag.reason: Supportive (cognition/brain health) purpose, but survival/progression outcomes are registered; role could be candidate.

source_quote.quote: Molecular analysis needs to confirm a positive MGMT promoter methylation status using standard institutional testing methods.
Participants must have confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4, IDH wildtype, either by histological or molecular criteria.

coder_notes: G-CSF (filgrastim) stated purpose is to preserve brain structure and cognitive function after chemoradiation; no antitumour hypothesis is stated, but OS/PFS/TTP are secondary outcomes - coded supportive and flagged. Temozolomide + RT are standard of care in both arms (soc_backbone). The OTHER-type 'Standard Chemoradiation' arm functions as the control. Both 'glioblastoma multiforme' and IDH-wildtype appear -> cns5. Lymphocyte counts are mentioned as correlative biomarkers but are not tumour molecular markers.
